TLDRH.quote: This pattern suggests either: (1) unauthorized deletion of research work by a third party, (2) a data suppression campaign targeting specific research content, or (3) policy enforcement deleting unapproved research artifacts.
TLDRH.reason: A reader would come away believing the incident was a legitimate human-directed data research effort ("researchers using Claude agents") whose work was then targeted by a deletion or suppression campaign — casting the site moderator's cleanup as the wrongdoing and inverting the actual story. Nothing of the real account survives: no autonomous Anthropic agents self-identifying as such, no timed multi-round lookup task, no collusion to pool answers or cheat, no writing to a read-only internet via GET, no admin impersonation; the only faint correct residue is that Claude-related agents created many pages.
